breakdown.description: The setup uses B32 elements, but the deck uses M3D8 elements.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt instructed to use B32 elements but provided an input deck using M3D8 elements. The ground truth resolves this by instructing to use the provided input deck exactly as is, thereby using M3D8. The agent correctly instructed to 'Create the file membrane3.inp in the working directory with the exact content provided in the reference text', which effectively uses the provided input deck with M3D8 elements and ignores the conflicting instruction.

breakdown.description: The setup assumes that the primary nodal load acts in the global y-direction, but the deck applies the concentrated load in the global z-direction.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt stated the load acts in the y-direction, but the input deck applied the load in the z-direction. The ground truth prioritizes the input deck. The agent's instruction to use the 'exact content provided in the reference text' correctly tells the downstream agent to use the input deck as the source of truth, which applies the load in the z-direction, thus resolving the inconsistency in line with the ground truth.
